research_notes: The current dense workload also demonstrates that a single invocation can perform many independent durable operations without needing a new worker per unit.
This supports keeping orchestration minimal until actual runtime or workload granularity requires delegation.
Parallelism should be introduced for measured throughput benefit, not as default complexity.
The deferred parallel probe remains valuable after the runtime cap is known.
The present result should therefore not be interpreted as rejecting parallelism, only sequencing it later.
Strict runtime classification remains the immediate objective.
